title: Hayden Island Boat Rentals
specs: Located on the Columbia River in Portland, Oregon
Boats equipped with GPS and/or depth/fish finder on most
Non-licensed boaters pay an additional $99 Liability Fee and must fill out a Safety Checklist
Children 12 and under must wear life jackets
includes: All safety equipment, insurance and a tank of gas
Bluetooth stereo with surround speakers, ambient floor lighting, fire extinguisher, air horn, flares, life jackets for every passenger
blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats equipped with Bluetooth stereo, ambient lighting, safety equipment, and life jackets. Boats come in various configurations and include GPS or depth/fish finders on most. Optional USCG-licensed captain available for charter.
extraNote: Fully-refundable $250 security deposit required for all rentals · Cancellation policy available on website (details not stated here) · Located outside Navigator Coffee Co., 12006 N Jantzen Drive, Portland, Oregon 97217
